title: Verniman method: auction, order flow and execution knowledge base
summary: A source-backed method library covering 27 blog topics, plus local Daily Map calendar archives for 2011–2025 and January 1–October 30, 2026, with captured text/images where recovered and explicit source gaps, including the reviewed empty 2011–2013 recoveries, including recovered 2014–2016 archive sources and the partial 2017 source trail.
data_summary: Method review: 27 pages, 46 videos, 42 caption exports. Daily Maps: 2026 has 201 maps/198 dates plus two undated commentaries; 2025 has 246/242; 2024 has 251/247; 2023 has 248/245; 2022 has 158/157, May 16–December 30, plus separate older context; 2021 has 250/246 plus one malformed-date article; 2020 has 251/248 with 502 image references across 502 unique files, including one qualified 400-pixel inline chart; 2019 has 248/246 with 496 image references across 495 unique files; 2018 has 249/245 with 496 image references across 496 unique files and one text-only source article. 2017 has 28/28, November 20–December 29, plus twelve undated daily plans and 80 plan images; five educational context records remain raw outside daily counts. 2016 recovers 160 maps/160 dates, January 5–December 1, from 135 archived HTML sources and 25 exact Atom entries, with 560 current-source fallback images whose historical bytes are unverified. 2015 preserves 79 daily records: 65 dated maps/65 dates, March 26–December 31, plus fourteen undated Opening Print posts, with 246 qualified fallback images from 62 exact HTML sources and 17 exact Atom entries. Sixty-three context records remain raw outside daily counts. 2014 preserves 37 daily records: 35 dated plans/35 dates, June 3–November 25, plus two undated Opening Print posts, with 111 unique qualified fallback images from eleven archived HTML articles, one homepage post and twenty-five exact Atom entries in two original XML payloads. Fifty-two context revisions and five supporting daily revisions remain raw outside selected daily counts. 2013 has no selected dated or undated daily plans and no daily images; all 365 dates remain gaps. Its 28 raw context pages retain 34 image references and 22 unique image payload hashes outside daily counts; three current daily bodies match 2022 saved capsules exactly. 2012 has no selected dated or undated daily plans or daily images; all 366 dates, including February 29, remain gaps. Thirty-eight pages were recovered from 39 attempted locators; the Weak Start exact archive snapshot returned HTTP 404 twice. Twenty-eight actual recovered daily bodies match frozen 2022 capsules; a separately retained Weak Start 2022 version is supporting context, not recovery of the failed archive. All 60 raw image references remain outside daily counts through 59 source-element responses and 59 unique payload hashes. The retained official sitemap has 31 current 2012 locators, all covered by CDX with no extras. 2011 has no selected dated or undated daily plans or daily images; all 365 dates remain gaps. Its 70 raw records comprise seventeen successful archived HTML captures, fifty exact entries from two actual 2011 Atom feeds and three explicitly current-only sitemap observations. All 73 actual bodies were independently reviewed; three daily-looking bodies match frozen 2022 plans exactly. All 81 visible media references remain retained outside daily counts, with 59 successful source-element pairs and 58 distinct payload hashes. Fifty unavailable references are explicit 1x1 tracking pixels; zero authored chart images are missing. All eleven current 2011 sitemap locators are accounted for: eight covered by CDX and three retained only as current context. All 5,782 scoped calendar dates across sixteen annual snapshots recorded; no market-data calculations.
evidence_status: Qualitative source research and local source preservation. Annual snapshots retain gaps and duplicate dates. The 2022 early-year gap, source-year exceptions, malformed dates and image qualifications remain explicit. Near ATHs uses its independently reviewed 2021 date in that annual archive; completed earlier snapshots are unchanged. The 2018 December 24 article has no source images, and its publication/update claims do not replace anchored body dates. The 2017 trail has only 28 dated plans and twelve undated daily plans; navigation exhausts without a 2016 boundary, so historical completeness is not claimed. The 2016 archive recovery has 101 weekday and 105 weekend gaps, no observed 2015 boundary and no full historical-completeness claim; all 560 image responses retain unverified historical byte identity. The 2015 recovery has 196 weekday and 104 weekend gaps, fourteen unresolved daily-plan dates, no observed 2014 boundary and qualified historical-image uncertainty. Nine identical overlaps retain their raw supporting revisions; exact Older CDX checks were empty, while rate-limited availability probes remain unresolved. The 2014 recovery has 226 weekday and 104 weekend gaps, two unsupported Opening Print dates, no observed 2013 boundary and no historical full-year completeness claim; all 111 current-source images have unverified historical byte identity. Five daily overlaps retain raw supporting revisions, including two literal Update/Opening title changes. Eight image-only update or closing bodies remain raw context because they do not establish a morning plan. Exact observed Older/feed-next CDX and availability checks all returned successful empty results. The reviewed empty 2013 recovery has 261 weekday and 104 weekend gaps and no selected daily plans. Standard and observed Blogger 2013 feed discovery and exact observed Older continuation checks returned successful empty results; no 2012 boundary, historical-absence or completeness claim follows. Raw educational/out-of-scope pages remain retained, including three bodies independently matched to 2022. The reviewed empty 2012 recovery has 261 weekday and 105 weekend gaps, including leap day, with no selected daily plans. One exact Weak Start archive snapshot failed with HTTP 404 on both bounded attempts, explicitly separate from retained 2022 supporting evidence. All current 2012 sitemap locators are accounted for. No 2011 boundary, historical-absence or historical-completeness claim follows; original 2013–2026 archives remain unchanged. The reviewed empty 2011 recovery has 260 weekday and 105 weekend gaps, with no selected daily plans or images. All seventeen indexed archive pages were recovered successfully; two actual 2011 Atom snapshots retain their original XML and exact selectors. The actual feed-next CDX and availability checks returned successful empty results. Three current-only observations retain their actual clocks without archive clocks or historical 2011 year assignments. Three daily-looking bodies match frozen 2022 plans exactly. All unavailable media references are explicit 1x1 tracking pixels, with no missing authored chart images. No 2010 boundary, historical-absence or historical-completeness claim follows; original 2012–2026 archives remain unchanged. No trading validation.
